main:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Reads multiple test cases, each containing a list of slice sizes and a target number of equal slices, and computes the minimum number of cuts needed to achieve at least d equal slices by analyzing the frequency of duplicate sizes and the presence of double-value relationships." main]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> args </REF>: String[] "Command-line arguments (unused)"
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
        <REF> sb </REF>: StringBuffer "Accumulated output string containing the result for each test case"
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Initialize a BufferedReader to read from standard input, read the first line as an integer t representing the number of test cases, and initialize a StringBuffer to accumulate output. RESULT br, t, sb]
            [COMMAND For each test case z from 1 to t, append the case label 'Case #z: ' to the output buffer. RESULT sb]
            [COMMAND Read the next two lines of input, tokenize them, and parse the first token from the first line as integer n and the first token from the second line as integer d. RESULT n, d]
            [COMMAND If n equals 1 and d equals 3, append '2' followed by a newline to the output buffer and continue to the next test case. RESULT sb]
            [COMMAND If n equals 1 and d equals 2, append '1' followed by a newline to the output buffer and continue to the next test case. RESULT sb]
            [COMMAND Create a long array of size n, populate it by parsing the remaining tokens from the second input line, and sort the array in ascending order. RESULT array]
            [COMMAND Create a Pair array of size n, iterate through the sorted array to count consecutive duplicate values, and store each unique value with its frequency as a Pair object in the array. RESULT ps, w]
            [COMMAND Sort the Pair array from index 0 to w, ordering the pairs by their frequency. RESULT ps]
            [COMMAND If the frequency of the most common element (ps[0].count) is greater than or equal to d, append '0' followed by a newline to the output buffer and continue to the next test case. RESULT sb]
            [COMMAND If d equals 2 and the frequency of the most common element is 1, append '1' followed by a newline to the output buffer and continue to the next test case. RESULT sb]
            [COMMAND If d equals 3, the frequency of the most common element is 2, and its value is not the maximum value in the array, append '1' followed by a newline to the output buffer and continue to the next test case. RESULT sb]
            [COMMAND If d equals 3, the frequency of the most common element is 2, and its value is the maximum value in the array, check if the second most frequent element also has a frequency of 2; if so, append '1' followed by a newline and continue to the next test case. RESULT sb]
            [COMMAND If d equals 3, the frequency of the most common element is 2, and its value is the maximum value in the array, search for any pair of elements in the array where one is exactly double the other; if found, append '1' followed by a newline and continue to the next test case. RESULT sb, flag]
            [COMMAND If d equals 3, the frequency of the most common element is 2, its value is the maximum value in the array, and no double-value pair was found, append '2' followed by a newline and continue to the next test case. RESULT sb]
            [COMMAND If d equals 3 and the frequency of the most common element is 1, search for any pair of elements in the array where one is exactly double the other; if found, append '1' followed by a newline and continue to the next test case. RESULT sb, flag]
            [COMMAND If d equals 3, the frequency of the most common element is 1, and no double-value pair was found, append '2' followed by a newline and continue to the next test case. RESULT sb]
            [COMMAND After processing all test cases, close the BufferedReader and print the accumulated output buffer to standard output. RESULT sb]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

    [ALTERNATIVE_FLOW: When n equals 1 and d equals 3]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Append '2' followed by a newline to the output buffer and continue to the next test case. RESULT sb]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_ALTERNATIVE_FLOW]

    [ALTERNATIVE_FLOW: When n equals 1 and d equals 2]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Append '1' followed by a newline to the output buffer and continue to the next test case. RESULT sb]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_ALTERNATIVE_FLOW]

    [ALTERNATIVE_FLOW: When the frequency of the most common element is greater than or equal to d]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Append '0' followed by a newline to the output buffer and continue to the next test case. RESULT sb]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_ALTERNATIVE_FLOW]

    [ALTERNATIVE_FLOW: When d equals 2 and the frequency of the most common element is 1]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Append '1' followed by a newline to the output buffer and continue to the next test case. RESULT sb]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_ALTERNATIVE_FLOW]

    [ALTERNATIVE_FLOW: When d equals 3, the frequency of the most common element is 2, and its value is not the maximum value in the array]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Append '1' followed by a newline to the output buffer and continue to the next test case. RESULT sb]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_ALTERNATIVE_FLOW]

    [ALTERNATIVE_FLOW: When d equals 3, the frequency of the most common element is 2, its value is the maximum value in the array, and the second most frequent element also has a frequency of 2]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Append '1' followed by a newline to the output buffer and continue to the next test case. RESULT sb]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_ALTERNATIVE_FLOW]

    [ALTERNATIVE_FLOW: When d equals 3, the frequency of the most common element is 2, its value is the maximum value in the array, and a double-value pair is found]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Append '1' followed by a newline to the output buffer and continue to the next test case. RESULT sb]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_ALTERNATIVE_FLOW]

    [ALTERNATIVE_FLOW: When d equals 3, the frequency of the most common element is 2, its value is the maximum value in the array, and no double-value pair is found]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Append '2' followed by a newline to the output buffer and continue to the next test case. RESULT sb]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_ALTERNATIVE_FLOW]

    [ALTERNATIVE_FLOW: When d equals 3, the frequency of the most common element is 1, and a double-value pair is found]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Append '1' followed by a newline to the output buffer and continue to the next test case. RESULT sb]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_ALTERNATIVE_FLOW]

    [ALTERNATIVE_FLOW: When d equals 3, the frequency of the most common element is 1, and no double-value pair is found]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Append '2' followed by a newline to the output buffer and continue to the next test case. RESULT sb]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_ALTERNATIVE_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
